يحتضن (form VIII)

# يَحْتَضِنَّ (yaḥtaḍinna) /jaħ.ta.dˤin.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
# يُحْتَضَنُ (yuḥtaḍanu) /juħ.ta.dˤa.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْت
